Context: 2. Income from house property

Where an employee has income under any other head, viz., income from house property, dividend, interest, etc., he can furnish the particulars. of such income and tax deducted at source thereon to his employer in the prescribed form and the employer can compute the total tax liability taking into account such income also and deduct appropriate tax from salary.
